sources.title: High Insurance Council instruction - Article 8 corresponding damage
used_for: Conventional vehicle definition: market value < 50% of annual bodily ceiling
Non-conventional vehicle definition: >= 50%
Component-wise corresponding damage to the most expensive conventional car

sources.title: Central Insurance circular - non-conventional vehicles and the victim's own body insurance
used_for: Article 8 non-corresponding excess may be paid by the victim's own body policy
No regulatory mandate to treat that body payment as a claims-history event or to deduct a franchise
Any such insurer treatment must be disclosed at issuance; ambiguity favours the insured (Regulation 71)

sources.title: Central Insurance circular 1400/401/146850 - total-loss salvage and franchise ordering
used_for: Salvage is not itself damage
Total-loss franchise is calculated after probable salvage is deducted

sources.title: Compulsory Third-Party Insurance Law 1395
used_for: Minimum bodily and financial commitments
Financial commitment = 2.5% of bodily commitment
Non-conventional vehicle limitation on financial compensation
Statutory recourse against the at-fault party
sources.access_note: Accessed as Statute Article 8 reproduced inside the Central Insurance motor-insurance compilation.

sources.title: Bimeh.com - 1405 diyah table
used_for: Reports 1405 sacred-month full diyah at 2.8 billion tomans
Basis for the derived 1.4bn-toman conventional threshold and 70m-toman minimum financial commitment
sources.access_note: Secondary source. The 50% and 2.5% derivation rules are primary law; the 1405 diyah base is not yet primary-verified.
